Built in the 505. Ready to work.

Three friends. One mission. A cleaner community.

Our company all started with three guys who met at New Mexico Military Institute. What began as side gigs helping people around the local area quickly grew into something more. Those early jobs showed us the value of hard work, dependable service, and doing right by our customers—and inspired us to bring our skills back home to the 505.

Our mission is simple: make junk removal easier, more affordable, and dependable for the people and businesses in our community. We bring care and attention to every job, with hardworking crews dedicated to serving our clients. From the first conversation to the final cleanup, we focus on efficiency, precision, and your satisfaction.

We take pride in showing up ready to work, treating every property with respect, and delivering quality service at rates that make sense. When you call Junkyard Boys Co., you get a crew that cares about the work—and the community we call home.
